status.title: Event Bus
status.description: In-memory only - resets on every backend restart.

connector.subtitle: Twitch · {{login}}
connector.enableDescription: Opens one EventSub WebSocket connection for this account when enabled.
connector.noAccounts: No connected Twitch or YouTube account yet. Connect one from Settings to enable engagement.
connector.permissionUpgradeExplanation: Chat and event reading needs extra Twitch permissions this account has not granted yet. Your existing stream key and metadata publishing are not affected.
connector.authorizeStarted: A new authorization was started on Twitch. Enter the code {{userCode}} on Twitch's activation page to continue.
connector.disableConfirmMessage: This closes the active connection and stops reading Twitch chat and events for this account. It does not disconnect the account or affect metadata publishing.

blockers.accountUnhealthy: This account needs to be reconnected

youtubeConnector.subtitle: YouTube · {{login}}
youtubeConnector.enableDescription: Polls the selected broadcast's live chat for this account when enabled - the first poll is never treated as live (no history replay).
youtubeConnector.noBroadcastSelected: No broadcast is currently selected for this account - choose one from Settings to start receiving events.
youtubeConnector.disableConfirmMessage: This stops polling the selected broadcast's live chat for this account. It does not disconnect the account or affect metadata publishing.

feed.title: Recent events
feed.description: A bounded diagnostic feed - not the operator chat or an overlay.
feed.gapNotice: Some events may have been missed (the stream reconnected or fell behind).
